title: Hearty Irish Potato Stew
description: A tangy, glassy-jelly Irish stew with massaman paste, slow-cooked in a ttukbaegi, perfect for a dairy-free date night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi over medium heat and sauté the diced onion, minced garlic, sliced carrots, and diced celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the massaman curry paste and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the diced potatoes, coconut milk, vegetable broth, and thyme, then bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the ttukbaegi, and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste, then stir to combine.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the liquid to thicken slightly.
Serve hot straight from the ttukbaegi, garnished with fresh thyme or a drizzle of coconut cream if desired.
Pair with a crusty baguette or a side of roasted carrots for a complete meal.
